tooltip_definitions.Total GAAP Revenue: Consolidated GAAP net revenue from SoundHound's conversational and agentic voice AI platform ($62.42M in Q3 2026, up +48.4% YoY from $42.05M in Q3 2025 and +0.8% QoQ from $61.90M in Q2 2026).

tooltip_definitions.Enterprise Conversational AI & Amelia Un: Customer service agents, IT helpdesk automation, and healthcare patient triaging inherited from Amelia acquisition ($9.82M in Q3 2026).
tooltip_definitions.Consumer Apps & Other Emerging: Legacy consumer mobile applications, music identification, and specialized developer licensing ($2.60M in Q3 2026).
tooltip_definitions.GAAP Gross Profit: GAAP gross profit of $21.28M in Q3 2026 (34.09% gross margin), down from 45.12% in Q2 2026 due to negative gross margin contracts from legacy acquisitions.
tooltip_definitions.GAAP Operating Income: GAAP operating loss of -$46.50M in Q3 2026 ($21.28M Gross Profit - $67.78M OpEx), reflecting R&D investments and integration restructuring.
tooltip_definitions.GAAP Diluted EPS: GAAP diluted net loss per share of -$0.10 in Q3 2026 based on 460M weighted average common shares outstanding.
tooltip_definitions.Operating Cash Burn: Operating cash flow burn of -$95.99M in Q3 2026, elevated by acquisition payments, Amelia severance, and working capital realignments.
tooltip_definitions.Capital Expenditures: Capital expenditures of $1.12M in Q3 2026, reflecting the lightweight cloud-native nature of voice model training.
tooltip_definitions.Reported Free Cash Flow: Operating cash flow (-$95.99M) minus CapEx ($1.12M), delivering -$97.11M in Q3 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Stock-Based Compensation: Equity awards and stock incentives of $61.02M in Q3 2026, driven by acquisition retention grants and new engineering hires.
tooltip_definitions.True Free Cash Flow: Economic cash generation deducting CapEx ($1.12M) and non-cash SBC ($61.02M) from OCF (-$95.99M), yielding -$158.13M in Q3 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Contract Pruning Strategy: Management's deliberate decision to non-renew negative margin legacy contracts, temporarily muting revenue growth to accelerate EBITDA profitability in 2027.
tooltip_definitions.Synergy Cost Reductions: Identified $120M in annualized run-rate cost synergies ($80M effective before Jan 1, 2027), targeting sustained positive adjusted EBITDA in 2H 2027.
tooltip_definitions.FY 2026 Guidance: Full-year 2026 revenue guided to $250M - $260M ($255.0M midpoint), with 2027 revenue projected between $350M - $400M.
tooltip_definitions.Available Liquidity: Cash and cash equivalents of $207.6M as of September 30, 2026, providing sufficient runway through 2027 profitability crossover.
